lines.text: Paid ads in Ryze, on autopilot.
This is the paid ads side of Ryze. Google and Meta in one place — spend, budgets, results — one dashboard.
Hook it up once. Under Integrations, open the Advertising tab — connect Google Ads and Meta, and the agent sees every campaign.
Back on the Dashboard, meet your co-pilot. Open the agent and ask: where am I overspending? It walks every campaign and comes back with the leaks, in dollars.
[warm] And you don't even have to ask. It audits your account around the clock — every finding lands in Approvals, and you apply it with one click.
It makes the ads too — creatives in your brand style, straight into your library. That one has a guide of its own.
Need a starting point? Grab one of the ready-made ad templates — or peek at Competitor Ads and see exactly what everyone else is running.
[warm] So: connect once, and let the agent watch your money. Paid ads, on autopilot.
